request_envelope.data: object; required for endpoints that need input
request_envelope.api_token: string; optional, required only when server is launched with --api-token

ndarray_encoding.dtype: numpy dtype string, for example float32 or bool

required_arguments_without_mock.run_dir: Training run directory containing config.yaml and, by default, dataset_stats.json.
required_arguments_without_mock.checkpoint: FastWAM checkpoint path loaded via model.load_checkpoint().

optional_arguments.dataset_stats_path: Explicit dataset stats JSON. If omitted, server uses ${run_dir}/dataset_stats.json.
optional_arguments.device: Torch device string. Default: cuda:0; falls back to cpu when CUDA is unavailable.
optional_arguments.action_horizon: Override predicted action chunk length. Default: cfg.data.train.num_frames - 1.
optional_arguments.num_inference_steps: Override diffusion inference steps. Default: cfg.eval_num_inference_steps or 10.
optional_arguments.api_token: Optional shared token checked on every request.
optional_arguments.mock: Start a zero-action mock policy without loading model weights.

response.shape_meta: FastWAM processor shape_meta loaded from the training config

input_image.type: numpy.ndarray or torch.Tensor serialized by msgpack
input_image.dtype: float32 preferred; server casts to model dtype
input_image.notes: H and W must match the FastWAM training processor image size and be multiples of 16. A shape_meta-keyed dict is also accepted, for example {"camera_0": ndarray}; the server selects cfg.data.train.shape_meta.images[0].key.

proprio.type: numpy.ndarray or torch.Tensor serialized by msgpack
proprio.notes: For Ego Humanoid configs D is 50. A shape_meta-keyed dict is also accepted, for example {"default": ndarray}; the server normalizes this through processor.action_state_transform and processor.normalizer.

prompt.required: required when context/context_mask are not provided
prompt.notes: Use only when the loaded FastWAM model has a text encoder available.

context.required: required with context_mask when prompt is not provided
context.type: numpy.ndarray or torch.Tensor serialized by msgpack
context.notes: Cached text embeddings. For Wan2.2 TI2V FastWAM configs C is typically 4096 and L is cfg.data.train.context_len.

context_mask.required: required with context when prompt is not provided
context_mask.type: numpy.ndarray or torch.Tensor serialized by msgpack

data.options: object or null; currently ignored by FastWAMPolicy.get_action

mutual_exclusion: Send either prompt or context/context_mask, not both.

action.notes: Action is denormalized back to dataset/action space before returning.
